text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Endleeeessly stretchiiing ooon~~♪ 
Winning~~♪ the Soooouuul♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuughh!! I'm so moved!! That was the 
absolute beeest~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're crying way too much. Well, you 
didn't do badly, though...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, my singing is by no means good. Though 
I do practice hard for the concerts...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Because singing comes 
from the heart! Taishin, Hayahide, you're 
both great at it, waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not really, but... you've got more volume 
in your voice than me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"T-Taishi~n...! Ehe, ehehehe! You really 
think so~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, I wasn't complimenting you! I was 
just stating the facts...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm still super happy!! Hehehe, Taishin 
actually has great rhythm and is super 
good at it, you know!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I know! Wanna battle it out in scoring 
mode? Let's each sing our signature song!! 
After all, we're rivals when it comes to 
singing, tooã£!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, looks like it is about time. I 
shall take the stage.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, hey! Let's all sing one 
last song together before we finish! All 
right, queuing it up now~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this is... quite typical of us, I 
suppose...
